snippet.title: City States: Medieval | Early Access Release Date Announcement Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
City States: Medieval launches April 20 on Steam.
Wishlist Today 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4066390/City_States_Medieval/

Build your city, expand a trade empire, and defend it in real-time warfare.
You are the leader of a city-state in high medieval Europe. Expand your city through deep city-building systems, build a trade empire across the known world, and lead men to war to defend trade routes in a high-stakes struggle of global strategy and brutal tower defense warfare.

#medieval #rts #strategygames
